messages:
maya: Hey team — we're hitting IP/ENI limits in us-west-2 while trying to bring up the new Dedicated GPU pool (p4d). Several node boots failed with networking errors this morning.
raj: Seeing same. Kubelet logs from one failing node:
```
E0325 10:14:02.123456 1 remote_runtime.go:123] Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to allocate pod IP: no available addresses on ENI eni-0abc123def456
```
leo: Root cause looks like we exhausted available secondary private IPs per subnet + account EIP limit. Autoscaler kept launching, ended up with ENIs that can't attach IPs.
tess (cloud-tam): I've opened a support case with AWS and escalated to the TAM. Case ID: 1234567891. Requested increases:
- Elastic IPs (v4) per region: 5 -> 80
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) per VPC: default raise to match target capacity
- Secondary private IPs per subnet: increase to support 40 p4d hosts * expected 8 ENIs each
raj: AWS asked for exact numbers per AZ and justification. Maya, can you paste expected node counts by AZ + instance type?
maya: Sure — plan is 40 p4d.24xlarge nodes total, split 3 AZs (15/15/10). Each node will attach a primary ENI + 4 secondary ENIs for SR-IOV/nic partitioning; each ENI needs up to 8 secondary private IPs for pods. So rough calc: 40 nodes * (1+4) * 8 = 1600 secondary IPs + buffer => request 3k per AZ.
ops-bot: Reminder: IPv6 would avoid EIP scarcity but we need IPv4 for third-party integrations and customer NAT. Can't migrate yet :eyes:
leo: For immediate mitigation we can: 1) throttle autoscaler to stagger launches, 2) reserve smaller warm pool in another region, 3) use eni-prefix-delegation where supported. But prefix delegation isn't available for p4d in us-west-2 right now.
tess (cloud-tam): AWS indicated they can raise EIP quota and per-VPC ENI/IPv4 address pool if we provide traffic/capacity justification. They may need a week for full approval, faster with TAM.
maya: I'll submit the formal quota request now and attach workload doc + expected cost. Draft justification:
"Launching Dedicated GPU pool for customer inferencing. Requires contiguous IPv4 addresses for per-node ENIs and public egress via EIPs. Estimated capacity: 40 p4d nodes; peak outbound NAT flows ~12k connections/min. Need EIP quota to support static mapping for load balancers and admin access."
raj: After request, ping me — I'll escalate to account team and add demand numbers for next 90 days.
infra-bot: Deploy job #deploy-2025-11-03-77 failed: 6 nodes failed to join due to ENI IP allocation errors. See logs at https://redwood.internal/logs/abc123
leo: Quick ask — can we also request increase in ENIs-per-instance limits? Some instance sizes limit number of attachable ENIs which constrains our design.
maya: Good catch. Include ENIs-per-instance -> allow 8 for p4d.24xlarge (current default 4 in us-west-2 for our account).
ops-bot: Action items:
- maya: submit quota requests + justification (in progress)
- raj: escalate with account team + follow-up
- leo: implement autoscaler backoff to prevent concurrent launches
- tess: monitor AWS case and update thread
maya: submitted case 1234567891 with the above. I'll paste AWS confirmation email here when it arrives. :thumbsup:
raj: Thanks — once we have the approvals we'll run a staged launch (5 -> 15 -> 40) and watch for IP pressure.
infra-bot: Note: consider long-term solution of IPv6 + NAT64 for egress-heavy workloads; opened RFC-2025-12-ipv6-eval for design.
